display_long_description:
**Why You’ll Love It:**


🌱 **Simple & Fun VR Farming**

Throw seeds, watch them grow, and harvest with real VR physics. Big, shiny, and weird plants — every harvest feels different
                                                                                                                                                                           
[media]

🏃 **Daily Parkour Challenges = Faster Growth**

Complete fun parkour trials every day to boost plant growth, earn rewards, and upgrade your farm faster. Skill = progress.

[media]

👫 **Play Together in a Shared World**

See other players, visit their farms, help each other, trade seeds, or just run around and have fun together.

[media]

🎨 **Customize Your Farm & Character**

Decorate your farm, unlock cosmetics, and show your style to everyone around you.

[media]

📸 **Clip-Ready & Funny Moments**

Fails, speedruns, huge harvests, and co-op chaos — perfect for clips and sharing.

[media]

🚧 **Early Access — More Coming Soon**

New parkour maps, plants, events, and cosmetics are added regularly. Your feedback helps shape the game.

👉 Jump in now and grow your farm faster with parkour and friends.
